svg.title: LAF Agent architecture
svg.desc: A turn goes from the app to the server, which sends it to a Bot over AG-UI. Every tool call the Bot makes returns through the gateway, which resolves the target, decides it against the configured policy, records an audit row, and only then acts, or refuses and names the rule. Allowed actions reach the account's computer, one container holding Chromium, logins and a workspace shared by every Bot. Decisions, threads and memory land in PostgreSQL.
